name: pi-session-finder
description: Cross-project session search & jump for pi. Adds /find <keywords> that full-text searches every past session across all projects and switches to the match — like /resume, but driven by content search.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(!process.env.CI)throw new Error('publish via release.yml CI: push a v* tag. Manual npm publish is blocked.')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
